description: This Java class implements a custom StatsCounter for Caffeine cache metrics, integrating with Ditto Metrics to track cache statistics such as hits, misses, evictions, load times, and cache size estimates.

classes.name: MetricsStatsCounter
classes.description: A final class implementing StatsCounter, providing metrics tracking for Caffeine cache via Ditto Metrics.

classes.name: MetricName
classes.description: An enum defining various metric names used for cache statistics, such as hits, misses, evictions, and load times.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a MetricsStatsCounter instance for a specific cache, with suppliers for max size and estimated size.

methods.name: recordLoadSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful cache load, including load time.

methods.name: recordLoadFailure
methods.description: Records a failed cache load, including load time.

methods.name: recordEviction
methods.description: Records a cache eviction with default weight.

methods.name: recordEviction
methods.description: Records a cache eviction with specified weight.

methods.name: recordInvalidation
methods.description: Records an invalidation of a cache entry.

methods.name: recordInvalidationWithoutItem
methods.description: Records an invalidation that did not remove an existing item.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current cache statistics as CacheStats object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MetricsStatsCounter instance.
